const requestId=s(audit.request_id); const recipient=s(audit.recipient); const leadId=s(audit.lead_id); const propertyId=s(audit.property_id); const dealId=s(audit.deal_id); const retryRaw=Number(input.crm_retry_count??input.retry_count??0); const retryCount=Number.isFinite(retryRaw)&&retryRaw>=0?Math.floor(retryRaw):0; const maxRaw=Number($env.COMMUNICATION_CRM_MAX_RETRIES??2); const maxRetries=Number.isFinite(maxRaw)&&maxRaw>=0?Math.floor(maxRaw):2; const base=$('Normalize CRM Reconciliation Request').first().json; const status=Number($response.statusCode||0); const receipt=$json; const persisted=status>=200&&status<300; const nextRetry=base.reconciliation.retry_count+1; return[{json:{...base,crm_persistence:{status:persisted?'persisted':'failed',http_status:status,retry_count:nextRetry,receipt},next_action:persisted?'CRM communication audit reconciliation succeeded; no provider resend occurred.':nextRetry<base.reconciliation.max_retries?'CRM persistence remains failed; retain the same audit ID and retry count for the next reconciliation pass.':'CRM persistence retry limit reached; route the audit to manual reconciliation without resending the communication.'}}}];

const base=$json; const reason=base.reconciliation?.dnc_suppressed?'dnc_suppressed':(base.reconciliation?.retry_count>=base.reconciliation?.max_retries?'retry_limit_reached':'reconciliation_not_allowed'); return[{json:{...base,crm_persistence:{status:'not_retried',reason},next_action:reason==='dnc_suppressed'?'No CRM retry and no provider resend.':reason==='retry_limit_reached'?'Route to manual CRM persistence reconciliation; do not resend the communication.':'Do not retry until the reconciliation request is complete and eligible.'}}}];
